{{short description|Physicist}}
'''Paul Lecoq''' is a senior physicist at the [[European Organization for Nuclear Research]] (CERN), [[Geneva, Switzerland]]. He was named [[Fellow of the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers]] (IEEE) in 2015 for "contributions to scintillator detectors for high-energy physics and medical imaging".<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ieee.org/membership_services/membership/fellows/2015_elevated_fellows.pdf|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150330134212/http://www.ieee.org/membership_services/membership/fellows/2015_elevated_fellows.pdf|url-status=dead|archive-date=March 30, 2015|title=2015 elevated fellow|website=IEEE Fellows Directory}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Professor Paul Lecoq – TICAL Aims for Paradigm Shift in PET Imaging|url=https://www.scientia.global/professor-paul-lecoq-tical-aims-paradigm-shift-pet-imaging|access-date=26 September 2018|work=Scientia|date=27 September 2017}}</ref>
